name: tomnomnom/waybackurls
description: Accepts line-delimited domains on stdin and fetches all known URLs from the Wayback Machine for wildcard domain patterns, outputting them to stdout.
score_rationale: Classic and reliable URL discovery tool with 4.4k stars from tomnomnom, a foundational tool in bug bounty recon workflows despite its minimal footprint.
summary: Accepts line-delimited domains on stdin and fetches all known URLs from the Wayback Machine for wild
